map.ETc = Kc × ETo：作物系数乘参考蒸散量。: ETc = Kc × ETo: the crop coefficient times the reference evapotranspiration.
map.ETo 和 ETc 区别？: What is the difference between ETo and ETc?
map.ETo 是参考作物（草地）蒸散，由气象站提供；ETc 是具体作物的实际需水，乘作: ETo is the evapotranspiration of a reference crop (grass) supplied by a weather station; ETc is the actual water need of a specific crop, obtained by multiplying by the crop coefficient Kc. Both are in mm.
map.FAO-56 给出主要作物各生育期 Kc 参考值，国内也可查《灌溉试验规范》或当: FAO-56 gives reference Kc values for the main growth stages of major crops; in China you can also consult the Irrigation Experiment Standards or the local agricultural academy recommendations. Mulching and shading change the actual Kc.
map.Kc 去哪查？: Where do I look up Kc?
map.→ 打开作物需水量（蒸腾蒸发ET）计算工具: -> Open the crop water requirement (evapotranspiration ET) calculator tool
map.作物需水量（蒸腾蒸发ET）计算 使用指南: How to use the crop water requirement (evapotranspiration ET) calculator
map.依据参考作物蒸散量ET₀、作物系数与生育阶段，计算作物需水量，指导灌溉定额，适用: Based on the reference crop evapotranspiration ET₀, the crop coefficient and the growth stage, it computes the crop water requirement to guide the irrigation quota, for farmland irrigation design, water-saving irrigation and water management.
map.光照累积量（每日光积分DLI）计算: Light accumulation (daily light integral DLI) calculation
map.小麦灌浆期需水: Water requirement at the wheat grain-filling stage
map.按 FAO 参考蒸散发法：作物需水量 ETc = Kc × ET₀。ET₀ 为参: Following the FAO reference evapotranspiration approach: crop water requirement ETc = Kc × ET₀. ET₀ is the reference crop evapotranspiration (mm/day) and Kc the growth-stage crop coefficient; their product gives the daily water requirement. Multiply by the planting area and divide by the irrigation efficiency to get the gross irrigation volume. Area is in mu (666.67 m2), for irrigation quotas and water-saving irrigation design.
map.按生育阶段取不同 Kc（苗期小、中期大）分段累计。: Take a different Kc for each growth stage (small at seedling, large in the main season) and accumulate stage by stage.
map.用于灌溉制度制定与缺水预警。: Used for irrigation scheduling and water shortage warnings.
map.：当地 ETo = 5.0 mm/d，灌浆期 Kc = 1.15，则 ETc =: : with local ETo = 5.0 mm/d and a grain-filling stage Kc = 1.15, ETc = 1.15 × 5.0 = 5.75 mm/d. Over 20 days this stage needs about 115 mm, i.e. 76.7 m³/mu (1 mm = 0.667 m³/mu).
